title: Microsoft 365 outage (12-13 Nov 2026): Microsoft's SLA promises 99.9% monthly uptime for Exchange Online; credits 25%/50%/100% below 99.9%/99%/95%; claims not automatic, must reach Microsoft by 31 Dec (incident EX1550543); CSP/reseller customers claim via partner; free/personal plans excluded. Outage began Thu night IST, some users down up to about a day; Microsoft 'deeply sorry', cause an earlier network capacity upgrade, not a cyberattack; IndiGo and Akasa Air email support hit.
headline: Microsoft Promised 99.9% Uptime. Outage-Hit Firms Can Claim Credits

alt_text: The Microsoft logo and name on a low sign outside the Microsoft Visitor Center (Building 92) in Redmond, behind green and yellow shrubs. Headline: Microsoft Promised 99.9% Uptime. Outage-Hit Firms Can Claim Credits. Further slides: a 25% credit when monthly uptime falls below 99.9% (50% below 99%, 100% below 95%); 31 December as the deadline for Microsoft to receive a claim; and the outage that began on Thursday night, 12 November, in India.
